comprehensive-divination-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive divination skill integrating four classic Chinese methods: Xiao Liu Ren, Liu Yao Na Jia, Mei Hua Yi Shu, and Da Liu Ren.
- Features intelligent routing to auto-recommend the optimal method based on question complexity, urgency, and domain.
- Implements strict 4-step workflow checkpoints using the `clarify` tool to confirm method and location (city/longitude) before any calculation.
- All time-dependent methods upgraded to use zhdate for precise lunar calendar, solar term, and ganzhi (stems/branches) computation.
- Adds true solar time (TST) correction for any city worldwide; calculates and displays local TST and offset before divination.
- Comprehensive knowledge base and Python calculation scripts included; known pitfalls and workflow traps extensively documented.
